notes: Read all 73 source lines before editing. Behaviour preserved 1:1: the exported `StatGridItem` interface (L6-14: label/value:string|number/unit?/icon?:ReactNode/trend?:'up'|'down'|'flat'/trendValue?/valueColor?) and `WidgetStatGridProps` (L16-20: stats/compact?/cols?:2|3|4) are ported verbatim; `autoCols(count)` (L22-26: count%3===0->3, count%4===0->4, else 2) is ported verbatim as pure logic; the empty branch (L44-46) returns the empty state with the same literal 'No stats available' message (the source has no t() here, so the literal is kept — i18n intent unchanged); `resolvedCols = compact ? 1 : (cols ?? autoCols(stats.length))` (L48) is ported verbatim; each stat is keyed by stat.label (L54) and the StatCard trend prop is built only when stat.trend && stat.trendValue both exist, with {direction: stat.trend, value: stat.trendValue, positive: stat.trend === 'up'} (L59-67) verbatim; valueColor is applied to the value (L68 className).

L2 import StatCard from @/components/data-display: no native web-parity port exists yet, so the subset WidgetStatGrid uses is reproduced as <LocalStatCard> mirroring the web StatCard markup (web/src/components/data-display/StatCard.tsx) — a Card (rounded-lg border bg-[var(--surface-1)]) with a label+icon header row (`flex items-center justify-between`; label text-sm font-medium muted, icon muted slot), a value row (`flex items-baseline gap-1`; value text-2xl font-bold + optional muted text-sm unit), and the optional trend row (`flex items-center gap-1 text-xs`; arrow ↑/↓/— + tint green-600(#16a34a) when positive / muted when flat / red-600(#dc2626) otherwise). The web Card applies `className`(=valueColor) at the Card level and the value <span> has no explicit colour, so valueColor effectively colours the value — reproduced here by applying the resolved valueColor to the value AppText. The web Card `shadow-sm` has no faithful cross-platform native analog and is omitted (documented).

L3 import EmptyState from @/components/feedback: no native web-parity port exists yet, so the message subset is reproduced as <LocalEmptyState> (centred muted AppText), the WidgetChartSummary sibling precedent; the source's verbatim 'no-action: transient empty state' comment intent is preserved.
L4 import cn from @/lib/cn: Tailwind class concat has no native analog — dropped; the grid/card class strings become StyleSheet selection + computed widths.

L28-41 containerColsClass container-query table: CSS grid + the @container query (@xs≈16rem≈256px, @sm≈24rem≈384px) do not exist in React Native, so the responsive collapse is reproduced FAITHFULLY (rule 7) by measuring the grid's OWN rendered width via onLayout (the SmallMultiplesChart onLayout/Number.isFinite&&>0 precedent) and resolveContainerCols, which applies the SAME thresholds: cols 1/2 never collapse; cols 3 -> 1(<256)/2(<384)/3; cols 4 -> 2(<384)/4. Once measured each cell gets an exact pixel width=(gridWidth - gap*(cols-1))/cols with a columnGap gutter; before the first layout pass (and in Jest where onLayout does not fire) cells fall back to a `${100/cols}%` flexBasis (with Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY width so unmeasured uses the target cols), so every stat still renders and labels/values remain findable in tests. L50-51 grid div+cn(grid, containerColsClass[resolvedCols], compact?'gap-2':'gap-3') -> a flexDirection row + flexWrap View with rowGap=gap (gap-2->8 compact / gap-3->12) and conditional columnGap.

Primitive + token mapping (rule 5): <div>/<span> -> RN <View>/<AppText>; `type ReactNode` kept for the icon slot; useState/useCallback added for the onLayout width measurement. Tailwind spacing -> px (1u=4px: p-4->16, gap-1->4 (spacing.xs), gap-2->8, gap-3->12, text-2xl->24, text-sm->14, text-xs->12); font-medium->'500', font-bold->'700'; rounded-lg->borderRadius 12; var(--surface-1)->colors.surface, var(--glass-border)->colors.border, var(--text-primary)->colors.textPrimary, var(--text-muted)->AppText muted tone, so the light/dark cascade is preserved at the token boundary. The named Tailwind value colours passed as valueColor (text-red-400 #f87171, text-red-500 #ef4444, text-emerald-300 #6ee7b7, text-emerald-400 #34d399, text-emerald-500 #10b981, text-amber-300 #fcd34d, text-cyan-300 #67e8f9, text-white -> textPrimary) are kept as palette hex via VALUE_COLOR_MAP; unknown classes resolve to undefined so the value keeps its primary tone (the FleetStatsWidget 'named Tailwind value colours kept as palette hex' precedent). AppText is imported from ../../../../../components/ui/AppText and tokens from ../../../../../theme/tokens (5 levels up from features/dashboard/widgets/shared). No DOM elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components are imported.

Verified in apps/native: `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit) exit 0; `npm run lint -- --quiet` exit 0; `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles` all suites passed (no regression). The new shared module is self-contained and additive — it does not alter the existing sibling widget ports.
